name: com.oauth.huaweibranch.view.login.huaweiBranchLoginView
description: When the app requests sign-in, the CIB SDK Huawei Branch shows password login and configured Huawei, Facebook, and guest sign-in options; it also links to account creation and password recovery.
disableEffect: The app cannot use this CIB SDK sign-in screen, so its Huawei Branch login flow may fail.
